**Submission: "GovAlloc-COFOG: Harmonised General-Government Expenditure by COFOG Function with Provenance Flags"** ([Data article / Data descriptor / Data note])

Dear [Dr / Prof] [Editor surname],

We submit the above data article for *[Journal name]*.

**The data.** GovAlloc-COFOG v1.0 is an open, harmonised panel of general-government expenditure shares by function (COFOG) for up to 217 economies, 2000-2024, with socio-economic and governance indicators. It joins three official sources (Eurostat, OECD, IMF) with World Bank indicators on common country codes and years. Panel A16 has 825 complete country-years for 36 economies with 16 functions, Panel A10 has 1,526 country-years for 85 economies with 10 divisions, and Panel B has official World Bank sector series for 211 economies.

**What is new compared with the source portals.** The portals publish the same numbers in different layouts, levels and units. We provide one union with an explicit source-priority rule, simplex-ready targets that sum to 100 within each row, per-cell provenance and imputation flags, and a technical validation that is reproducible from the released files.

**Quality and honesty.** Targets are official statistics and are never imputed; imputed feature values are flagged cell by cell. The manuscript documents the limits: coverage is centred on Europe and the OECD, only three low-income economies are in the ten-division panel, some cells are negative as published, and a few IMF series jump. An earlier semi-synthetic dataset of ours is preserved, clearly marked, only to document an audit; it is not recommended for modelling.

**Reuse value.** Typical uses are benchmarking models that predict budget composition, public-finance and comparative-politics research, and explainability studies on compositional targets. The data paper states recommended splits and pitfalls (group by economy, no future leakage, compare with "same as last year").

**Availability.** The data are deposited on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24248315; v1.0: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24248316) under CC BY 4.0, with a mirror on Kaggle (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/pranavchaudhari24/govalloc-cofog-government-spending-by-function). Code is on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24255442) and GitHub (https://github.com/Pranav-chaudhari-2006/GovAllocXAI). Original providers' terms are listed in the paper and in the archive.

**Related work.** A companion benchmark study of explainable machine learning on these data is [submitted to / in preparation for] [venue]. This data article is original, has not been published and is not under consideration elsewhere.

**Use of generative AI.** Generative AI (Anthropic's Claude) was used for code scaffolding and drafting/editing support, as declared in the manuscript; the authors reviewed all content and take full responsibility.
